description: Serve a storefront on a domain your company owns (white label), such as agents.yourcompany.com. Answers with two DNS records to add at your DNS provider: a TXT record proving you own the domain and the record that routes it. Then call verify_storefront_domain. Last Price domains and hosting domains are refused. Only where the workspace has storefronts switched on (else an error with code not_released). Needs a Last Price credential with workspace settings write scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

domain.description: A domain your company owns, such as agents.yourcompany.com.

name: add_storefront_domain
